request.text: Please add a weekly meal-planning flow to Sunroom Pantry. Let me browse the recipes, plan dinners for Monday through Wednesday, and see a grouped shopping list. Keep the controls usable by keyboard.

reply: I’ve created a batch with three tasks. The weekly grid and recipe cards can run in parallel, while the shopping list waits for the recipes.

tasks.title: Add the weekly plan grid
tasks.description: Render a compact Monday through Wednesday dinner grid with named previous and next week controls.

tasks.title: Add recipe cards
tasks.description: Show the three available dinners as recipe cards with a short ingredient preview.

tasks.title: Build a grouped shopping list
tasks.description: Combine ingredients from the planned dinners by grocery aisle and display a simple checklist.

reviewFinding.summary: Give the previous-week button an accessible name so keyboard and screen-reader users can tell where it goes.

reviewNote: The weekly planner, recipe cards, and grouped shopping list are ready. The accessibility finding was fixed and the change set passed review.
